title: Your Brain in 24 Hours #shorts
description:
You'll have about 6,000 thoughts today… and that's not even the strangest number. Here's what your brain does in just 24 hours.

The facts:
• Your brain holds about 86 billion nerve cells
• You have about 6,200 thoughts a day (Queen's University study, 2020)
• Your fastest nerve signals travel up to ~120 m/s ≈ 430 km/h (≈ 270 mph)
• Your brain burns about 20% of your body's energy, at only ~2% of your weight
• It all runs on roughly 20 watts
• You dream for about 2 hours every night… and forget most of it

And all of this… inside your head!

Note: figures are approximate averages for a healthy adult.
